annotations.title: Read the fields of a job’s application form

description: Use this when the user wants to apply for a job (Bewerbung) from get_job_matches or list_saved_jobs through the employer’s form. `lesung.felder` lists its fields: `aus_cv` (from the resume), `offen` (shown as a form with MCP Apps; else ask all at once, numbered; decide what is left) and `nur_pro` (consents and personal characteristics: only the user sets them; never answer them or call them done). With `hintergrundlesung` the app or browser extension reads it in the background: give no link yet; with `ansichtMeldetSich` end your turn, the form view messages you; else wait `wiederFragenIn` seconds and call again. Without `lesung`, give `leselink` (the app or browser extension reads it and returns to the chat) or else `link`, then call again. `link` opens the filled form to submit: give it only at the end. No link yet with `hinweis`; do not quote it. With its `ansichtMeldetSich` ask the user to tick it in the form view and end your turn; else ask its `text` and after a yes call again with its `fassung` as `hinweis`. With `ohneFormular` there is nothing to fill: tell the user its `satz`, then use its `werkzeug`, or else link the job’s stellenseite. Scope: cv:lesen.
name: get_form_fields
title: Read the fields of a job’s application form
